summary: To deploy the MCP server on containerized AAP, add an [ansiblemcp] host group and set mcp_allow_write_operations and mcp_ignore_certificate_errors, plus mcp_tls_cert and mcp_tls_key for custom certificates.
questions: How do I deploy the Ansible MCP server on containerized AAP?
Which inventory group is used for the MCP server?

answer_card.title: Deploy the MCP server (containerized)
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[ansiblemcp]
aap.example.com

[all:vars]
mcp_allow_write_operations=false   # read-only
mcp_ignore_certificate_errors=false
mcp_tls_cert=<path>
mcp_tls_key=<path>
```
Run the `install` playbook; the service listens on HTTPS port **8448**.
